summary: Backend-only testing for iter39 Insurance Receivables + Statement PDF. All 18 pytest cases pass against public URL. Covered: list endpoint shape, providers sorted DESC by pending, aging_days/aging_bucket enrichment, insurance filter (case-insensitive), aging bucket filters (0-30 / 31-60 / 61-90 / 90+ with %2B encoding), invalid aging silently ignored, status pending/paid/all semantics, empty-provider zero result, auth required (401/403), seeded sale creation (cash 200 + insurance 400) via sale-level insurance_name/insurance_amount, statement-pdf returns signed https URL + totals, downloaded PDF starts with %PDF magic bytes, nonexistent insurer returns 200 with zero totals (valid empty PDF), empty insurance name returns 4xx, payment via /accounts-receivable/{id}/payment reduces balance (400->300) and status becomes partial, paid_in_period reflects >=100 in subsequent PDF, regression /api/clinic/accounts-receivable still 200.

minor.issue: Query param '+' is URL-decoded to space by FastAPI; callers must send '%2B'. Not a bug per se (standard HTTP), but the frontend must URL-encode the aging value. The spec says invalid buckets are silently ignored, which masks this if the FE sends raw '+'. Recommend FE encodeURIComponent on aging param.

action_items: Verify frontend InsurersTab uses encodeURIComponent for aging bucket (especially '90+') when building the query string, otherwise the backend will silently return all accounts.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/accounts_receivable.py exceeds 650 lines; consider splitting insurance-receivables + statement-pdf into a dedicated module (insurance_receivables.py).
statement-pdf imports reportlab inside the function on every call; acceptable but could be hoisted to module level to reduce latency.
statement-pdf does not validate date_from/date_to format; invalid ISO strings reach Supabase .gte/.lte filters and may 500. Consider explicit YYYY-MM-DD validation.

insurance_name path parameter is not stripped before the empty-name HTTPException check inside statement-pdf — a path containing only spaces may not reach that branch due to FastAPI routing (acceptable since 404 is returned).
seed_data_creation: Each test session creates one sale TEST_PDF_<ts> for patient Maria Garcia (dffcbc90-...) with items=Q600, cash=Q200, insurance_amount=400. A subsequent transfer payment of Q100 is registered on its AR.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Reusable backend test file: /app/backend/tests/test_iter39_insurance_receivables.py. 18/18 pass. Note: for 90+ aging filter, must URL-encode '+' as %2B (requests.params handles it automatically). Sale endpoint no longer accepts payment_method='insurance'; must use top-level insurance_name & insurance_amount keys.
